title: かいものひろば (Kaimono Hiroba)
description: It's year-end sale season at the shopping complex. A woman hunts for a new bag, a man needs furniture for his new apartment, and a teenager is looking for the perfect gift. Their paths cross at the sale tables, the elevator, and the lost-and-found counter — a comedy of bargains and near-misses.
author: オリジナル
